crossRefs.note: Yahweh is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? Yahweh is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?
Therefore we won’t be afraid, though the earth changes, though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas;
Yahweh of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge.
All the nations surrounded me, but in Yahweh’s name, I cut them off.
When the servant of the man of God had risen early, and gone out, behold, an army with horses and chariots was around…
What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?
The people of Israel were struck there before David’s servants, and there was a great slaughter there that day of…
The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers take counsel together, against Yahweh, and against his Anointed…

translations.web: I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people who have set themselves against me on every side.
translations.bsb: I will not fear the myriads set against me on every side.
translations.kjv: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people, that have set themselves against me round about.
translations.asv: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of the people That have set themselves against me round about.
